title: Feedback Received from Earn and Learn Programmes
what_it_is: Feedback Received from Earn and Learn Programmes

sections.label: ELP placements and sectors
sections.summary: In 2016 over 500 polytechnic and ITE graduates were placed in ELPs, exceeding the 400 target, with 40 ELPs across 23 sectors.

sentences.speaker: The Parliamentary Secretary to the Ministers for Education (Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim) (for the Minister for Education (Higher Education and Skills))
sentences.text: In 2016, over 500 polytechnic and ITE graduates were placed with companies across various ELPs.

sentences.speaker: The Parliamentary Secretary to the Ministers for Education (Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim) (for the Minister for Education (Higher Education and Skills))
sentences.text: This is more than the 400 placements targeted for 2016.

sentences.speaker: The Parliamentary Secretary to the Ministers for Education (Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim) (for the Minister for Education (Higher Education and Skills))
sentences.text: We have received positive feedback from both employers and trainees who have participated in ELP.

sentences.speaker: The Parliamentary Secretary to the Ministers for Education (Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim) (for the Minister for Education (Higher Education and Skills))
sentences.text: There are currently 40 ELPs across 23 sectors including those where the Industry Transformation Maps (ITMs) are being developed.

sentences.speaker: The Parliamentary Secretary to the Ministers for Education (Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim) (for the Minister for Education (Higher Education and Skills))
sentences.text: The most popular ELPs are in sectors, such as hotel, information and communications technology and logistics, where ITMs are developed.

sections.label: ELP entry pay feedback
sections.summary: Union feedback says entry pay in some industries is not attractive, limiting ELP's appeal; ELP is new and arrangements will be improved.

sentences.speaker: Mr Desmond Choo (Tampines)
sentences.text: While ELP has been important to bringing new talent into the industries, but there has been union feedback that the entry pay for some of these industries is not attractive, thereby limiting the attractiveness of ELPs as a whole.

sentences.speaker: Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim
sentences.text: As Members know, ELP is a new initiative.

sentences.speaker: Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim
sentences.text: We will learn along the way and are committed to improving the arrangements as well as to how we can make ELP more attractive to the participants.
